desc.en: Patent applications are examined by USPTO examiners. A final rejection can be appealed to the PTAB (ex parte appeal, §134).
desc.zh: 专利申请由 USPTO 审查员审查。最终驳回可以上诉到 PTAB（单方上诉，§134）。

nodes.name: Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB)
nodes.nameZh: 专利审判和上诉委员会（PTAB）

desc.en: An administrative tribunal inside the USPTO. It hears ex parte appeals from examiners and the AIA trials: inter partes review (IPR) and post-grant review (PGR).
desc.zh: USPTO 内部的行政审理机构，审理对审查员决定的单方上诉，以及 AIA 程序：多方复审（IPR）和授权后复审（PGR）。

desc.en: Since 20 October 2025 the USPTO Director decides whether to institute IPR and PGR trials, consulting at least three PTAB judges; most decisions are summary notices without reasons.
desc.zh: 自 2025 年 10 月 20 日起，IPR 和 PGR 是否立案由 USPTO 局长在咨询至少三名 PTAB 法官后决定，多数决定是只写结果、不写理由的简要通知。

deadlines.en: PGR petition: within 9 months of grant
deadlines.zh: PGR：授权后 9 个月内提出

deadlines.en: IPR petition: after the later of 9 months from grant or the end of a PGR
deadlines.zh: IPR：授权满 9 个月后（或 PGR 终结后）才能提出

deadlines.en: IPR barred if filed more than 1 year after service of an infringement complaint
deadlines.zh: 被送达侵权起诉状超过 1 年的，不能再提 IPR

deadlines.en: Institution decision within 3 months of the preliminary response
deadlines.zh: 收到初步答复后 3 个月内决定是否立案

deadlines.en: Final written decision within 1 year of institution (extendable by up to 6 months)
deadlines.zh: 立案后 1 年内作出最终书面决定（可延长不超过 6 个月）

desc.en: First-instance courts for patent infringement. Pharmaceutical Hatch-Waxman cases (ANDA litigation) are often filed in Delaware and New Jersey. Filing an ANDA with a Paragraph IV certification is itself an act of infringement (35 U.S.C. §271(e)(2)).
desc.zh: 专利侵权的一审法院。医药 Hatch-Waxman 案件（ANDA 诉讼）多在特拉华州和新泽西州提起。提交带有第四段声明的 ANDA 本身就构成侵权（35 U.S.C. §271(e)(2)）。

deadlines.en: Patentee has 45 days after receiving the Paragraph IV notice to sue and trigger the stay
deadlines.zh: 专利权人收到第四段声明通知后 45 日内起诉，才能触发等待期

deadlines.en: 30-month stay of FDA approval if suit is filed in time
deadlines.zh: 按时起诉的，FDA 批准暂缓 30 个月

deadlines.en: Damages only for infringement within 6 years before suit
deadlines.zh: 只能追溯起诉前 6 年内的侵权赔偿

nodes.name: Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit (CAFC)

desc.en: Hears all patent appeals from district courts and the PTAB, so it shapes most of US patent law in practice.
desc.zh: 统一审理来自地区法院和 PTAB 的专利上诉，实际上塑造了美国专利法的大部分规则。

desc.en: Takes only a few patent cases a year by certiorari, but those decisions set the rules for everyone below.
desc.zh: 通过调卷令每年只受理少数专利案件，但这些判决对下级法院和 USPTO 都有约束力。

desc.en: Invention applications undergo substantive examination on request. An applicant may request reexamination of a rejection within three months.
desc.zh: 发明专利申请经请求进行实质审查。申请人对驳回决定不服的，可以在三个月内请求复审。

deadlines.en: Request substantive examination within 3 years of filing
deadlines.zh: 申请日起 3 年内请求实质审查

deadlines.en: Request reexamination within 3 months of a rejection
deadlines.zh: 收到驳回决定 3 个月内请求复审

nodes.name: Reexamination and Invalidation Department, CNIPA
nodes.nameZh: 国家知识产权局复审和无效审理部

desc.en: Hears reexamination of rejections and requests to declare patents invalid. Anyone may request invalidation after grant, with no time limit. It also hears administrative adjudication requests in drug patent linkage.
desc.zh: 审理复审请求和无效宣告请求。专利授权公告后，任何人都可以请求宣告无效，没有期限限制。药品专利链接中的行政裁决也由国家知识产权局作出。

deadlines.en: Sue in court within 3 months of an invalidation decision
deadlines.zh: 对无效决定不服的，3 个月内向法院起诉

deadlines.en: Linkage: sue or request adjudication within 45 days after the application is published
deadlines.zh: 链接：药品审评机构公开上市申请之日起 45 日内起诉或请求行政裁决

sites.name: 中国上市药品专利信息登记平台

desc.en: First instance for administrative suits against CNIPA invalidation and reexamination decisions, and for drug patent linkage actions under Article 76.
desc.zh: 对国家知识产权局无效、复审决定提起的行政诉讼，以及专利法第七十六条药品专利链接诉讼的一审法院。

deadlines.en: Nine-month stay of chemical generic approval after the case is accepted
deadlines.zh: 法院立案或国家知识产权局受理后，化学仿制药设置 9 个月等待期

nodes.name: IP courts and designated intermediate courts
nodes.nameZh: 知识产权法院和指定的中级人民法院

desc.en: First instance for patent infringement suits.
desc.zh: 专利侵权纠纷的一审法院。

deadlines.en: Limitation period of 3 years from knowledge of the infringement and infringer
deadlines.zh: 诉讼时效 3 年，自知道或应当知道侵权行为和侵权人之日起算

nodes.name: IP Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court
nodes.nameZh: 最高人民法院知识产权法庭

desc.en: Hears second-instance appeals in invention patent cases, both civil infringement and administrative validity. Since 1 November 2023, utility model, technical secret and software appeals go to it only when major and complex; others go to the next higher court.
desc.zh: 审理发明专利的二审案件，包括民事侵权和行政确权。2023 年 11 月 1 日起，实用新型、技术秘密、计算机软件案件只有“重大、复杂”的才由其审理，其余上诉到一审法院的上一级法院。

sites.name: 最高人民法院知识产权法庭
